name: XAC Automation Corporation
summary: XAC Automation Corporation specializes in the global development, manufacturing, and distribution of electronic fund transaction terminals and their associated components. The company's portfolio extends to transaction security products, as well as versatile smart cards, card reading devices, and card writing equipment. Among its product offerings, XAC provides ECR POS and Customer Facing Devices—a secure Android-based platform designed for retail staff to process electronic fund transfers via payment cards. Additionally, the company delivers Handheld and Desktop systems, which boast innovatively designed hardware powered by a secure Android operating system, ideal for diverse mobile and stationary environments such as queue busting, curbside service, and tableside payments. Furthermore, XAC presents Unattended Outdoor Payment solutions, comprising flexible, robust, intuitive, and P2PE-compliant devices tailored for various self-service applications, including ticketing, fuel dispensing, parking meters, and general vending. It also supplies an integrated mPOS/printer/payment hub, designed as an all-in-one unit for both countertop and mobile payment scenarios. Beyond hardware, the company delivers a suite of software and services, including its proprietary cloud device management system, Terminal Management System (TMS) 2.0, XAC remote key injection capabilities, remote diagnostic tools, and comprehensive payment application solutions. Established in 1993, the company initially operated as XAC Technology before rebranding to XAC Automation Corporation in 1997. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
